tools.name: execute-task
tools.title: Execute OpenCode Task
tools.description: Execute an OpenCode build task from a caller-supplied prompt and model, persist its provider session behind an opaque continuation handle, and write artifacts in the supplied project directory.

prompt.description: Prompt to execute with opencode. The caller owns prompt construction and inclusion of any task data.

projectDir.description: Directory where opencode will run. A .opencode/skills symlink is created here pointing to /code/skills. Task-specific skills may create subdirectories as needed inside this directory.

model.description: OpenCode model identifier selected by the caller.

tools.name: continue-task
tools.title: Continue OpenCode Task
tools.description: Continue a previously completed or failed OpenCode task through its opaque Ploinky continuation handle.

handle.description: Opaque continuation handle issued by an OpenCode task whose provider session was created.

prompt.description: New user message to execute in the existing OpenCode session.
